items.title: Updated: Sustainability tools to use in 2026
items.summary: Welcome to the Trellis roundup of new products and services for sustainability professionals, as chosen by our editorial team.

items.title: Global adaptation finance pledge will leave developing nations with 70% of their needs unmet
items.summary: The UN Environment Programme (UNEP) has warned that COP30’s goal of tripling adaptation finance by 2035 will not be enough to close the adaptation finance gap, leaving developing nations with, at most, 29% of what they need.

items.title: MPs warn Britain is “dangerously” dependent on China’s critical minerals
items.summary: The Business, Innovation, Science and Trade Committee has called on the Government to de-risk the country's critical dependencies in order to safeguard national and economic security.

items.title: TWO WEEKS TO GO: Free masterclass on turning climate risk insights into adaptation action
items.summary: This webinar, held in partnership with SmartResilience on 19 November, will explore why and how leading organisations are moving from simply measuring risk to actively adapting in order to protect their operations, assets and supply chains.

items.title: Government unveils Energy Independence Bill to reform UK energy system
items.summary: The UK Government has introduced its Energy Independence Bill to Parliament, setting out reforms to energy bills, consumer protection, home efficiency and the development of renewable power.

items.title: Electricity demand from cooling systems to surge in the next decade
items.summary: Electricity demand from cooling systems will increase by 80% over the next 15 years, accounting for more than double the aggregate demand of either electric vehicles or data centres.

items.title: Everything you need to know about COP31
items.summary: The 31st Conference of the Parties (COP31) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) commences next week (9 November).

items.title: Q&A: What is the Brazil-led ‘deforestation roadmap’?
items.summary: On 3 November, the Brazilian presidency of the COP30 climate talks released its long-awaited “roadmap” on ending deforestation.

items.title: Q&A: What is in the global ‘roadmap’ for transitioning away from fossil fuels?
items.summary: Transitioning away from fossil fuels is “urgent, inevitable and, yet, possible”, according to a first-of-its-kind global “ roadmap ” produced by Brazil.

items.title: CB Live: Carbon Brief’s team at COP17 on the nature talks’ key outcomes
items.summary: Following this year’s UN COP17 biodiversity conference, Carbon Brief’s journalists hosted a livestream to explain what happened at the summit.
